title: ArcCivs .116 native tavern meals and restored work travel
assumptions: Baseline8cbae4d/0.1.115: eating consumes existing carried plain food. Adults lose1hunger per observed awake minute, children half; BREAD restores6hunger. Both rates remain unchanged. New routing makes an active controlled TAVERN the shared venue even without a keeper; blocked/unavailable venues retain carried-food emergency meals.

Owner-approved native tavern buffer is4BREAD per resident, minimum4 and maximum64 per active tavern:20for5 residents versus old4per assigned keeper or0when unstaffed. Ordinary cities receive no automatic item grants. Auto genuinely missing food is issued to an existing staffed reachable warehouse, then normal native courier receipts deliver it. Existing local/global/carried/incoming stock suppresses issuance; no new item is granted by an eating callback.

Low/base/high assumptions are1/10/16 active towns,5adults each,0.25/1/4awake hours/day. Long-run consumption50BREAD per town-hour gives12.5/50/200BREAD per town-day before and after; these averages are assumptions, not measured sessions, and initial hunger phase affects short windows. The new route changes access and delivery, not food nutrition or hunger frequency.

For one initially empty unstaffed tavern with5 residents, existing reachable BREAD of20/8/0 means0/12/20 one-time additional native BREAD may be needed to fund the20-unit venue buffer. This is explicit native item issuance when genuinely absent, not a claim of zero item issuance. Available existing bread is transferred rather than minted. Personal carried food remains real and separate from the venue buffer.

No direct Vault,token or playerXP operation is added. Courier profession training remains its current one successful-trip reward, separately from playerXP; additional real food trips may exercise that existing capped internal training. Existing output recipes, loot probabilities and item sale/contract behavior remain unchanged; no item-to-money exchange is assumed.

The existing single1000ms Auto-supply controller and8materials*64items receipt bound are retained. No new timer, meal-time grant, NPC-source debit, remote cargo credit or forced immigration is added. Runtime/client observations and actual demand cadence are separate from source and tests.

The parent-owned road fix restores existing working journey detours from the old misclassified idle0.55speed multiplier to the existing working0.8multiplier; no base work, recipe, loot or currency rate changes. Existing roads influence cost for all route types from a detached read-only snapshot, while only eligible working trips retain the existing recorded footprints. Idle routes gain no new learning footprint. Restored travel throughput can increase observed completed deliveries or production uptime; it is not a second item mint and no measured throughput claim is made.

The calculator recurring totals exclude the one-time shelf fill. Its separate one_time_native_bread_buffer row records initial issuance explicitly; multiplying this one-time amount by7 would incorrectly invent a weekly repeat.
